intro: Easy Strider Living is a local culinary task offered by Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine. She is eager to share her prized recipe for strider stew, provided an adventurer is willing to hunt down the fierce foreststriders wandering Darkshore and retrieve their meat.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Do you smell that delicious aroma? It's my secret recipe, friend--fresh strider stew. Delicious!
Perhaps you would be interested in learning the recipe?
Before I teach you the recipe, you will need to prove that you can handle the beasts.
Now, I don't expect you to go out and tame one and ride it back to me, but if you can kill a few and bring back some of their succulent meat, I may be persuaded to show you the ways of strider stew.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The pot is empty and I'm hungry! What's taking you so long?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Fantastic! Try it and tell me what you think, friend!
